descr.notes: 1,222,788 -> 330,456 (3.70x) at the SAME footprint. The whole win is ticks: ~100 local ticks/char -> ~10 glyphs/char. DESIGN: the entire 32-deep stack is ONE REGISTER. v = 3v + d with d in {1,2,3}, so v = 0 means empty and no sentinel is needed; pop is w = v - d, and valid iff w >= 0 and w % 3 == 0, which catches underflow AND shallow mismatches together. Widest reachable word (3^33-3)/2 = 2.78e15, three orders inside 2^63. No ring, no tape, no rotation. The stack lives in B, which `r` never clobbers, so the worker never spills — and that is exactly why there are THREE MEN: the worker can neve

brackets.note: 1,222,788 -> 330,456 (3.70x) at the SAME footprint. The whole win is ticks: ~100 local ticks/char -> ~10 glyphs/char. DESIGN: the entire 32-deep stack is ONE REGISTER. v = 3v + d with d in {1,2,3}, so v = 0 means empty and no sentinel is needed; pop is w = v - d, and valid iff w >= 0 and w % 3 == 0, which catches underflow AND shallow mismatches together. Widest reachable word (3^33-3)/2 = 2.78e15, three orders inside 2^63. No ring, no tape, no rotation. The stack lives in B, which `r` never clobbers, so the worker never spills — and that is exactly why there are THREE MEN: the worker can neve

subset-sum.note: The two-room split. 92x128 -> 80x84, area2 16,384 -> 7,056 (x0.43), ticks 267,010 -> 262,399. Room A = init + phase 2; room B = phase 3 + emit + no-solution. The seam is real: phase 3 and emit need only ring V and the O pipe, never ring B, so room B's interior is 33 against room A's 41. Ring B lives in the void BELOW room A (room A is 60 rows against room B's 74, so it is free) rather than in a widened band above. The relay room disappears entirely: a pipe may not loop back into its own room, which was the only reason ring V needed a turnaround — A -> B -> A is legal. THE UNMEASURED NUMBER CAM

Was 13/20. The failures were STEP-CAP, not wrong answers: plain lex-DFS hits 811,418 iterations worst case against 112,018 on the worst public case, and no per-iteration cost fits 15M ticks. Fixed by replacing the search, not the machine. Meet-in-the-middle with the right half fixed at 8 indices, so hL = n-8 is the only geometry derived from n. Cost is 2^hL * (2^hR + 1) = 1,052,672 comparisons at n=20 REGARDLESS of input. Lex order is free: left masks walked by a counter counting down, so the peeled mask is bitrev(counter), which visits index sets in exactly lexicographic order. True ceiling M

Dedicated dataflow machine, not the LM-1 ISA. Bit-parallel BFS run backwards from the flag, so each robot move is a local decision and the up/right/down/left tie-break falls out of neighbour order — no path storage. Distance mod 3 (the grid is bipartite) in three label planes whose roles rotate for free: pushing them back into the ring in a different order *is* the rotation. free = NB | S1 | S2 | S3, so no fifth plane. g = 255 - p (a 180 deg rotation) keeps every plane word non-negative, which makes bit tests branch-free. 51 blocks over one man, an 18-word ring, a spill FIFO and a scratch FIFO
